# Appendix: Transcript Corpus Listing

Complete listing of all transcript files in the `bootstrappers/` corpus. Files are organized by source directory.

---

## A. MicroConf Transcripts (486 files)

**Source:** `bootstrappers/MicroConf/`
**Format:** `[YouTube Video ID].en.txt` — YouTube transcripts auto-generated by the original corpus builder. Not human-reviewed. May contain errors.

## B. The Bootstrapped Founder Episodes (332 files)

**Source:** `bootstrappers/TheBootstrappedFounder/`
**Format:** `[Episode Number or Title].en.txt` — Podcast transcripts. Numbered episodes use the format `NNN: Title [YouTubeID].en.txt`. Unnumbered episodes use title-only format.
